proposals.name: llm_volume_confirmed_momentum_fbb95c98
proposals.economic_logic: Medium-term price trends are more sustainable when accompanied by robust trading volume, as volume validates institutional participation and consensus. Combining 20-day price momentum with volume confirmation isolates high-conviction trends from low-liquidity noise.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: China industry ETFs exhibiting high 20-day momentum paired with strong volume confirmation will outperform their cross-sectional peers over a 10-day horizon.
failure_modes: Sudden, macro-driven market regime shifts causing violent mean reversion in high-momentum sectors.
High volume confirmation originating from distribution or climax selling rather than accumulation.

proposals.name: llm_volatility_adjusted_short_term_reversal_4fb816b5
proposals.economic_logic: Short-term overreactions (5-day reversal) are more reliable alpha sources when scaling down in highly volatile environments, where structural noise dominates. Dividing short-term reversal by 20-day historical volatility stabilizes the signals against erratic cross-sectional variance.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETFs with high short-term mean-reversion tendencies normalized by lower baseline volatility deliver superior cross-sectional risk-adjusted excess returns.
failure_modes: Persistent fundamental shocks causing short-term price movements to extend into strong structural trends.
A severe reduction in market liquidity rendering historical volatility estimations unrepresentative of current tail risk.
